rules.statement: The bridge must support the conversion profile: FIXED/INCR/WRAP burst types, legal lengths, 1/2/4-byte transfer sizes, and PSTRB/PPROT conversion.
The bridge has no timeout or CSR, so the system must provide a default APB error Completer.
The bridge must tolerate APB waiting indefinitely, as it has no timeout.

rules.condition: A lint finding is reported by the VLSIT v2 rule checks or Verilator/slang lint flow
rules.statement: Any lint finding must be fixed or reported under the skill rules, with no project-specific waivers.
The AXI Manager must comply with AXI4 WLAST/AWLEN and WSTRB rules; no RTL recovery is defined for malformed write traffic.
Reset must cancel local state without replay or rollback, which requires coordinated system reset.
The APB address map/decoder must provide a match or a default response with PREADY=1 and PSLVERR=1.
